There's diagetic music and non-diagetic music. Diagetic music means that the music is in the scene. That means a radio in the scene is playing a song from the radio and the characters can hear it in the movie. We can also hear it. Non-diagetic music means the music isn't in the story world, it's not in the scene, it's overlayed on the film. The characters can't hear non-diagetic music. We can hear it.

SPR goes silent from the non-diagetic music during the battle sequences to make it feel more real. The non-diagetic music comes on at many other points in the film to elicit emotion. Music in films can help or hinder a film. If the elements on screen are great, and the writing is compelling, music can support it and lift it even higher. If the writing in bad, and the scenes are also bad, the music has to work overtime and be much better than what will suffice.
